dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.supervisor_scope: Showing hajiri for the work sites assigned to you.
dashboard.mark_remaining: Mark {count, plural, one {# remaining} other {# remaining}}
dashboard.no_workers_body: Add your existing staff or hire through KaamSathi to start tracking hajiri and payroll.
dashboard.attendance_14d_hint: Workers present, on leave and absent each day
dashboard.chart_empty: No hajiri recorded in the last 14 days.
dashboard.no_jobs: No open job openings. Post one and our team will shortlist verified workers.
dashboard.no_payroll: You haven't run payroll yet. Create a wage sheet for this month from hajiri.
dashboard.wage_bill_hint: Estimated gross pay of active workers this month

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Organization details, team members, work sites, shifts and holidays.
settings.org_readonly: Only owners and admins can change organization details.
settings.section_tax_hint: Printed on wage sheets and payslips.
settings.weekly_off_hint: Paid weekly day off. Days with no hajiri on this day count as weekly off.
settings.pan_hint: 9-digit PAN from the Inland Revenue Department.
settings.ward_invalid: Enter a ward number between 1 and 35
settings.vat_hint: Turn on if your business is registered for VAT.
settings.members_intro: People who can use KaamSathi for your organization. Supervisors only see hajiri and leave for their assigned sites.
settings.invite_hint: They log in with an OTP sent to this mobile number.
settings.role_hint_owner: Full access, including members and billing.
settings.role_hint_admin: Full access, including members and billing.
settings.role_hint_hr: Hiring, workers, hajiri, leave and payroll. No members or billing.
settings.role_hint_supervisor: Marks hajiri and handles leave for assigned sites only.
settings.assigned_sites_hint: The supervisor can mark hajiri only at these sites.
settings.supervisor_needs_site: Assign at least one site to a supervisor
settings.no_sites_yet: No work sites yet. Add a site in the Work sites tab first.
settings.member_active_hint: Inactive members can't log in to this organization.
settings.remove_member_body: {name} will lose access to this organization.
settings.sites_intro: Places where your workers report. Each site has a QR code for hajiri check-in and an optional geofence.
settings.sites_empty_body: Add your hotel, building site or factory to start QR hajiri.
settings.site_active_hint: Inactive sites are hidden from hajiri and job forms.
settings.geofence_hint: Workers checking in with the QR code must be within this distance of the site.
settings.latlng_both: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty
settings.location_unavailable: Location isn't available on this device.
settings.location_denied: Couldn't get your location. Check location permission.
settings.radius_invalid: Enter a radius between 20 and 5000 metres
settings.qr_hint: Print and display this at the site. Workers scan it in the KaamSathi app to check in.
settings.qr_print_hint: Tip: print at least 10 cm wide and keep it where workers enter.
settings.rotate_qr_body: The current printed QR code will stop working immediately. You'll need to print and display the new one.
settings.delete_site_body: {name} will be removed. Workers assigned to it will keep their records.
settings.shifts_intro: Standard working hours. Overtime is counted beyond the shift's working hours.
settings.shifts_empty_body: Add your morning, day or night shift timings.
settings.holidays_intro: National public holidays apply to everyone. Add your own holidays (e.g. a company anniversary) — these are paid days off in payroll.
settings.add_holiday_hint: A paid holiday for your organization only.
settings.delete_holiday_body: {name} will no longer be a paid holiday.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Your plan, monthly estimate and charges.
billing.admins_only: Only owners and admins can view billing.
billing.charges_empty_body: Charges appear here when a hire joins or a monthly subscription is billed.
billing.price_placement_body: Charged only when a worker we shortlisted joins your organization.
billing.price_replacement_body: If a placed worker leaves within 30 days of joining, the replacement hire is free.
billing.price_subscription_body: Covers hajiri, leave, peski and payroll. Minimum {min} per month, billed at the start of each B.S. month.

landing.eyebrow: Hiring and workforce platform for Nepal
landing.headline: Verified workers. On-time pay.
landing.subhead: Hire verified cooks, guards, masons and more — then run hajiri, leave and payroll in one place, in Nepali or English, on the B.S. calendar.
landing.hire_title: Hire verified workers in days, not weeks
landing.hire_body: Post an opening and our ops team shortlists verified, available workers matched on trade, district and experience.
landing.hire_p1: Citizenship and skill (NSTB) checks before anyone reaches you
landing.hire_p2: Clear pipeline: shortlisted → interview → selected → joined
landing.hire_p3: Ratings and verified work history from past employers
landing.manage_title: Manage hajiri, leave and peski without the register
landing.manage_body: Supervisors mark hajiri on their phone — even offline. Workers can self check-in by scanning the site QR code.
landing.manage_p1: QR check-in at each work site
landing.manage_p2: Geofence makes sure workers are actually on site
landing.manage_p3: Leave requests and salary advances tracked automatically
landing.payroll_title: Payroll that follows Nepal's labour law
landing.payroll_body: Generate the B.S. month wage sheet from hajiri with minimum wage, overtime, SSF and TDS calculated for you.
landing.payroll_p1: Bilingual wage sheet (तलब पाना) and bank transfer files
landing.payroll_p2: SSF 11% + 20% and TDS by current tax slabs
landing.payroll_p3: Payslips sent to workers on their phone
landing.pricing_body: Pay for results. No setup fee.
landing.price_hire_note: Only when a worker joins. Free replacement within 30 days.
landing.workers_body: Get verified once and get matched with hotels, hospitals, security companies and builders. See your hajiri and payslips in the KaamSathi app.
landing.workers_free: Workers never pay — KaamSathi is always free for workers.
landing.cta_title: Ready to hire and pay with confidence?
landing.cta_body: Log in with your mobile number — set up your organization in two minutes.
